General of the Right Valiant Cavalry Guard

value.action: lecture hall at his temple was struck by thunder

sourceDate.text: 晉天福七年四月…至八年四月
晉天福七年四月…至八年四月
同光元年冬十二月辛卯

units.zh: 五行志
units.en: Treatise on the Five Elements
units.literal: Treatise on the Five Elements

units.zh: 昔武王克商，以箕子歸，作《洪範》。
units.en: In ancient times, after King Wu of Zhou conquered Shang, he brought Jizi home and composed the 《Great Plan》.
units.literal: In antiquity, when King Wu conquered Shang, he brought Jizi back and composed the 《Hong Fan》.

units.zh: 其九疇之序，一曰五行，所以紀休咎之征，窮天人之際。
units.en: Of the nine divisions in sequence, the first is the Five Elements, meant to record omens of blessing and calamity and to probe the relationship between Heaven and humanity.
units.literal: Among the nine categories in order, the first is called the Five Elements, by which to record signs of fortune and misfortune and to exhaust the boundary between Heaven and man.

units.zh: 故後之修史者，咸有其說焉。
units.en: For this reason, later historians all set forth their own accounts of it.
units.literal: Therefore later compilers of histories all have their explanations thereof.

units.zh: 蓋欲使後代帝王見災變而自省，責躬修德，崇仁補過，則禍消而福至，此大略也。
units.en: The aim was broadly to teach later rulers that when they witnessed disasters and portents they should reflect on themselves, take personal responsibility, cultivate virtue, cherish benevolence, and remedy their faults—then misfortune would fade and good fortune follow. Such is the general idea.
units.literal: It is broadly intended to make later emperors, on seeing disasters and anomalies, examine themselves, blame their own persons and cultivate virtue, esteem benevolence and repair faults—then calamity is dispelled and blessing arrives; this is the general purport.

units.zh: 今故按五代之簡編，記五行之災沴，追為此誌，以示將來。
units.en: I have therefore drawn on the brief annals of the Five Dynasties to record disasters associated with the Five Elements, compiled this treatise for posterity, and set it forth for those who come after.
units.literal: Now therefore, following the brief annals of the Five Dynasties, I record disasters and calamities of the Five Elements, compile this treatise retrospectively, and present it to posterity.

units.zh: 其於京房之舊說，劉向之緒言，則前史敘之詳矣，此不復引以為證焉。
units.en: As for the older theories of Jing Fang and the introductory remarks of Liu Xiang, earlier histories have already treated them at length, and they are not cited again here as evidence.
units.literal: As for the old doctrines of Jing Fang and the prefatory remarks of Liu Xiang, earlier histories have narrated them in detail; here they are not cited again as proof.

units.zh: ○水淹風雨
units.en: ○ Floods and Storms
units.literal: ○ Floods and wind-rain

units.zh: 梁開平四年十月，梁、宋、輝、亳水，詔令本州開倉賑貸。
units.en: In the tenth month of the fourth year of Kaiping of Later Liang, the regions of Liang, Song, Hui, and Bo were flooded. An edict ordered each prefecture to open its granaries for relief grain loans.
units.literal: In the tenth month of the fourth year of Kaiping of Liang, Liang, Song, Hui, and Bo were inundated; an edict ordered the respective prefectures to open granaries for relief loans.

units.zh: 十一月，大風，下詔曰：「自朔至今，異風未息，宜命祈禱。」
units.en: In the eleventh month a violent wind arose. An edict declared: "From the first of the month until now the abnormal wind has not subsided. Prayers should be commissioned."
units.literal: In the eleventh month there was a great wind; an edict was issued saying: "From the first of the month until now the strange wind has not ceased; prayers should be ordered."

units.zh: 唐同光二年七月，汴州雍丘縣大雨風，拔樹傷稼。
units.en: In the seventh month of the second year of Tongguang of Later Tang, Yongqiu County in Bian Prefecture was struck by heavy rain and wind that uprooted trees and damaged the crops.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the second year of Tongguang of Tang, Yongqiu County in Bian Prefecture had heavy rain and wind; trees were uprooted and crops damaged.

units.zh: 曹州大水，平地三尺。
units.en: Cao Prefecture suffered severe flooding, with water three feet deep across the flatlands.
units.literal: Cao Prefecture had great flooding; on level ground the water stood three feet deep.

units.zh: 八月，江南大雨溢漫，河水溢漫流入鄆州界。
units.en: In the eighth month torrential rains in the south caused widespread flooding, and the swollen rivers poured into the borders of Yan Prefecture.
units.literal: In the eighth month, heavy rain in Jiangnan overflowed and spread; river water overflowed and spread into the territory of Yan Prefecture.

units.zh: 十一月，中書門下奏」：「今年秋，天下州府多有水災，百姓所納秋稅，請特放加耗。」
units.en: In the eleventh month the Secretariat submitted a memorial: "This autumn many prefectures across the realm suffered flooding. We request that the autumn tax surcharges for wastage paid by the common people be specially remitted."
units.literal: In the eleventh month the Secretariat memorialized: "This autumn many prefectures throughout the realm suffered flood disasters; the autumn tax paid by the common people—please specially remit the surcharge for wastage."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The request was granted.
units.literal: The request was approved.

units.zh: 三年六月至九月，大雨，江河崩決，壞民田。
units.en: From the sixth through the ninth months of the third year, heavy rains caused rivers to burst their banks and destroy farmland.
units.literal: From the sixth month to the ninth month of the third year, heavy rain caused rivers to burst their banks and ruined the people's fields.

units.zh: 七月，洛水泛漲，壞天津橋，漂近河廬舍，艤舟為渡，覆沒者日有之。
units.en: In the seventh month the Luo River surged, destroying the Tianjin Bridge and sweeping away houses along its banks. People crossed by boat, and drownings occurred every day.
units.literal: In the seventh month the Luo River rose in flood, destroyed the Tianjin Bridge, swept away dwellings near the river, and people moored boats to cross; those capsized and drowned occurred daily.

units.zh: 鄴都奏，御河漲於石灰窯口，開故河道以分水勢。
units.en: Yedu reported that the Imperial Canal had swollen at Lime Kiln Pass and that old channels were reopened to divert the floodwaters.
units.literal: Yedu reported that the Imperial Canal rose at Shihuiyao Pass; old river channels were opened to divide the force of the water.

units.zh: 鞏縣河堤破，壞廒倉。
units.en: The river dike at Gong County burst, destroying the state granaries.
units.literal: The river dike at Gong County broke, destroying the granary storehouses.

units.zh: 八月，敕：「如聞天津橋未通往來，百官以舟船濟渡，因茲傾覆，兼踣泥塗。
units.en: In the eighth month an edict declared: "We have heard that the Tianjin Bridge still cannot be used for passage and that officials are crossing by boat, with capsizings and people thrown into the mud as a result.
units.literal: In the eighth month an edict stated: "As we hear, the Tianjin Bridge still does not permit passage; civil and military officials cross by boat, and because of this they capsize, and moreover fall into the mud.

units.zh: 自今文武百官，三日一趨朝，宰臣即每日中書視事。」
units.en: Henceforth civil and military officials shall attend court once every three days, while the chief ministers shall conduct daily business at the Secretariat."
units.literal: From now on civil and military officials shall attend court once every three days; the chief ministers shall conduct Secretariat affairs daily."

units.zh: 四年正月，敕：「自京以來，
units.en: In the first month of the fourth year an edict declared: "From the capital eastward,
units.literal: In the first month of the fourth year an edict stated: "From the capital eastward,

units.zh: 〈（案：此句疑有脫誤。）〉
units.en: (Editorial note: This sentence is suspected to contain omissions or errors.)〉
units.literal: (Editorial note: This sentence is suspected to contain omissions or errors.)〉

units.zh: 幅圜千里，水潦為沴，流亡漸多。
units.en: for a thousand li in every direction flooding has become a calamity, and displaced persons are steadily increasing.
units.literal: for a thousand li in breadth and girth, flooding became a calamity, and displaced persons gradually increased.

units.zh: 宜自今月三日後，避正殿，減常膳，撤樂省費，以答天譴。
units.en: Beginning three days from now, the main hall should be avoided, regular meals reduced, music suspended, and expenses cut back, in response to Heaven's rebuke.
units.literal: It is fitting that from three days after this month the main hall be avoided, regular meals reduced, music withdrawn and expenses curtailed, in answer to Heaven's reproof.

units.zh: 應去年經水災處鄉村，有不給及逃移人戶，夏秋兩稅及諸折科，委諸處長吏切加點檢，並與放免，仍一年內不得雜差遣。
units.en: In villages that suffered flooding last year, local officials are ordered to inspect closely all households that lack provisions or have fled, and to remit their summer and autumn taxes and all apportioned levies. For one year no miscellaneous corvée duties shall be imposed on them.
units.literal: In villages in places that suffered flood disaster last year, for households that lack provisions or have fled and relocated, the summer and autumn taxes and all apportioned levies are entrusted to local chief officials for strict inspection, and all are to be remitted; moreover, for one year no miscellaneous corvée assignments shall be imposed.

units.zh: 應在京及諸縣，有停貯斛斗，並令減價出糶，以濟公私，如不遵守，仰具聞奏。」
units.en: In the capital and in all counties, wherever grain is held in reserve, officials are ordered to sell it at reduced prices to relieve public and private distress. Failure to comply must be reported to the throne."
units.literal: In the capital and in all counties, wherever grain is stored in reserve, all are ordered to sell it at reduced prices to relieve public and private need; if this is not obeyed, report in full to the throne."

units.zh: 長興元年夏，鄜州上言，大水入城，居人溺死。
units.en: In summer of the first year of Changxing, Fu Prefecture reported that severe flooding entered the city and residents drowned.
units.literal: In summer of the first year of Changxing, Fu Prefecture reported upward that great flooding entered the city and residents drowned.

units.zh: 三年四月，棣州上言，水壞其城。
units.en: In the fourth month of the third year Di Prefecture reported that floodwaters destroyed its city walls.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the third year, Di Prefecture reported upward that water destroyed its city walls.

units.zh: 是月己巳，鄆州上言，黃河水溢岸，闊三十里，東流。
units.en: That month, on the jisi day, Yan Prefecture reported that the Yellow River overflowed its banks to a breadth of thirty li and flowed eastward.
units.literal: That month, on the jisi day, Yan Prefecture reported upward that the Yellow River overflowed its banks, thirty li in breadth, flowing eastward.

units.zh: 五月丁亥，申州奏大水，平地深七尺。
units.en: On the dinghai day of the fifth month Shen Prefecture reported severe flooding, with water seven chi deep across the flatlands.
units.literal: On the dinghai day of the fifth month, Shen Prefecture memorialized great flooding; on level ground the water stood seven chi deep.

units.zh: 是月戊申，襄州上言，漢水溢入城，壞民廬舍，又壞均州郛郭，水深三丈，居民登山避水，仍畫圖以進。
units.en: That month, on the wushen day, Xiang Prefecture reported that the Han River surged into the city and destroyed houses, and also breached the outer walls of Jun Prefecture. Water stood three zhang deep; residents fled to the hills for refuge and submitted painted records of the disaster.
units.literal: That month, on the wushen day, Xiang Prefecture reported upward that the Han River overflowed into the city, destroying commoners' houses; it also destroyed the outer walls of Jun Prefecture. The water stood three zhang deep; residents climbed mountains to escape the water and still painted diagrams to submit.

units.zh: 是月甲子，洛水溢，壞民廬舍。
units.en: That month, on the jiazi day, the Luo River overflowed and destroyed houses.
units.literal: That month, on the jiazi day, the Luo River overflowed and destroyed commoners' houses.

units.zh: 六月壬戌，汴州上言，大雨，雷震文宣王廟講堂。
units.en: On the renxu day of the sixth month Bian Prefecture reported heavy rain and thunder that struck the lecture hall of the Temple of King Wenxuan.
units.literal: On the renxu day of the sixth month, Bian Prefecture reported upward heavy rain; thunder struck the lecture hall of the Temple of King Wenxuan.

units.zh: 十一月壬子，鄆州上言，黃河暴漲，漂溺四千餘戶。
units.en: On the renzi day of the eleventh month Yan Prefecture reported that the Yellow River rose violently, sweeping away and drowning more than four thousand households.
units.literal: On the renzi day of the eleventh month, Yan Prefecture reported upward that the Yellow River rose violently, sweeping away and drowning more than four thousand households.

units.zh: 三年七月，諸州大水，宋、亳、潁尤甚。
units.en: In the seventh month of the third year many prefectures were inundated, Song, Bo, and Ying most severely.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the third year, many prefectures suffered great flooding; Song, Bo, and Ying were especially severe.

units.zh: 宰臣奏曰：「今秋宋州管界，水災最盛，人戶流亡，栗價暴貴。
units.en: The chief ministers memorialized, "This autumn the flooding is worst within the jurisdiction of Song Prefecture. Households are fleeing and grain prices have soared.
units.literal: The chief ministers memorialized: "This autumn within the jurisdiction of Song Prefecture the flood disaster is most severe; households are displaced and grain prices have risen sharply.

units.zh: 臣等商量，請於本州倉出斛斗，依時出糶，以救貧民。」
units.en: We have deliberated and request that grain be taken from this prefecture's granaries and sold at seasonable prices to relieve the poor."
units.literal: We have deliberated and request that grain be taken from this prefecture's granaries and sold at the proper season to relieve the poor."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The request was granted.
units.literal: The request was approved.

units.zh: 是月，秦州大水，溺死窯谷內居民三十六人。
units.en: That same month Qin Prefecture was inundated, drowning thirty-six residents in Yaogu.
units.literal: That month, Qin Prefecture suffered great flooding; thirty-six residents within Yaogu were drowned.

units.zh: 夔州赤甲山崩，大水漂溺居人。
units.en: At Kuizhou Chijia Mountain collapsed, and floodwaters swept away and drowned the residents.
units.literal: At Kuizhou, Chijia Mountain collapsed, and great water swept away and drowned the residents.

units.zh: 清泰元年九月，連雨害稼。
units.en: In the ninth month of the first year of Qingtai, unceasing rain damaged the crops.
units.literal: In the ninth month of the first year of Qingtai, continuous rain damaged the crops.

units.zh: 詔曰：「久雨不止，禮有祈禳，禜都城門，三日不止，乃祈山川，告宗廟社稷。
units.en: An edict declared: "When prolonged rain will not stop, ritual prescribes prayers and exorcisms: perform exorcistic rites at the capital gates; if after three days the rain still does not cease, then pray to the mountains and rivers and announce the matter to the ancestral temple and the altars of soil and grain.
units.literal: An edict stated: "When long rain does not cease, ritual provides for prayer and exorcism: offer exorcistic rites at the capital gates; if after three days it still does not cease, then pray to mountains and rivers and announce to the ancestral temple and altars of soil and grain.

units.zh: 宜令太子賓客李延範等禜諸城門，太常卿李懌等告宗廟社稷。」
units.en: Palace Lecturer Li Yanfan and others are to perform exorcistic rites at the city gates, and Minister of Ceremonies Li Yin and others are to announce the matter to the ancestral temple and the altars of soil and grain."
units.literal: It is fitting to order Palace Lecturer Li Yanfan and others to perform exorcistic rites at the various gates, and Minister of Ceremonies Li Yin and others to announce to the ancestral temple and altars of soil and grain."

units.zh: 晉天福初，高祖將建義於太原，城中數處井泉暴溢。
units.en: At the beginning of the Tianfu era of Later Jin, as the High Ancestor was preparing to raise his banner at Taiyuan, wells and springs in several parts of the city suddenly burst forth.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianfu of Jin, when the High Ancestor was about to raise righteous forces at Taiyuan, wells and springs in several places within the city suddenly overflowed.

units.zh: 四年七月，西京大水，伊、洛、、澗皆溢，壞天津橋。
units.en: In the seventh month of the fourth year the Western Capital was inundated. The Yi, Luo, Chan, and Jian rivers all overflowed and destroyed the Tianjin Bridge.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year, the Western Capital suffered great flooding; the Yi, Luo, —, and Jian all overflowed and destroyed the Tianjin Bridge.

units.zh: 八月，河決博平，甘陵大水。
units.en: In the eighth month the Yellow River broke through at Boping, and Ganling was severely flooded.
units.literal: In the eighth month the Yellow River burst its banks at Boping; Ganling suffered great flooding.

units.zh: 六年九月，河決於滑州，一概東流。
units.en: In the ninth month of the sixth year the Yellow River broke through at Hua Prefecture and shifted entirely to an eastward course.
units.literal: In the ninth month of the sixth year the Yellow River burst its banks at Hua Prefecture and entirely flowed eastward.

units.zh: 居民登丘冢，為水所隔。
units.en: Residents took refuge on mounds and burial knolls, cut off by the floodwaters.
units.literal: Residents climbed mounds and tombs and were cut off by the water.

units.zh: 詔所在發舟楫以救之。
units.en: An edict ordered local authorities to dispatch boats for rescue.
units.literal: An edict ordered that wherever this occurred boats be dispatched to rescue them.

units.zh: 兗州、濮州界皆為水所漂溺，命鴻臚少卿魏比、將作少監郭廷讓、右金吾衛將軍安濬、右驍衛將軍田峻於滑、濮、澶、鄆四州，檢河水所害稼，並撫問遭水百姓。
units.en: The border regions of Yan and Pu prefectures were inundated. Wei Bi, Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments; Guo Tingrang, Assistant Director of Imperial Construction; An Jun, General of the Right Golden Crow Guard; and Tian Jun, General of the Right Valiant Cavalry Guard, were dispatched to Hua, Pu, Chan, and Yun prefectures to inspect flood-damaged crops and to comfort the afflicted populace.
units.literal: The borders of Yan and Pu prefectures were all swept and drowned by water; Honglu Vice Minister Wei Bi, Assistant Director of Imperial Construction Guo Tingrang, General of the Right Golden Crow Guard An Jun, and General of the Right Valiant Cavalry Guard Tian Jun were ordered in the four prefectures of Hua, Pu, Chan, and Yun to inspect crops damaged by the river water and also to comfort and inquire after the common people who suffered flooding.

units.zh: 兗州又奏，河水東流，闊七十里。
units.en: Yan Prefecture further reported that the river had shifted eastward and was seventy li wide.
units.literal: Yan Prefecture further reported that the river water flowed eastward, seventy li in breadth.

units.zh: 至七年三月，命宋州節度使安彥威率丁夫塞之。
units.en: By the third month of the seventh year Military Governor An Yanwei of Song Prefecture was ordered to lead laborers in blocking the breach.
units.literal: By the third month of the seventh year, Military Governor of Song Prefecture An Yanwei was ordered to lead laborers to block it.

units.zh: 河平，建碑立廟於河決之所。
units.en: Once the river was brought under control, a stele and shrine were erected at the site of the breach.
units.literal: When the river was pacified, a stele was erected and a shrine established at the place of the breach.

units.zh: 開運元年六月，黃河、洛河泛溢堤堰，鄭州原武、滎澤縣界河決。
units.en: In the sixth month of the first year of Kaiyun the Yellow River and Luo River overflowed their dikes and weirs, and the river broke through at the border of Yuanwu and Xingze counties in Zheng Prefecture.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Kaiyun, the Yellow River and Luo River overflowed dikes and weirs; at the border of Yuanwu and Xingze counties in Zheng Prefecture the river burst its banks.

units.zh: 周廣順二年七月，暴風雨，京師水深二尺，壞墻屋不可勝計。
units.en: In the seventh month of the second year of Guangshun of Later Zhou, a violent storm struck the capital. Water stood two feet deep, and countless walls and houses were destroyed.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the second year of Guangshun of Zhou, violent wind and rain struck; in the capital the water stood two feet deep, and ruined walls and houses were beyond counting.

units.zh: 諸州皆奏大雨，所在河渠泛溢害稼。
units.en: Prefectures throughout the realm reported heavy rains, with rivers and canals overflowing and damaging crops everywhere.
units.literal: All prefectures reported heavy rain; wherever they were, rivers and canals overflowed and damaged crops.

units.zh: 三年六月，諸州大水，襄州漢江漲溢入城，城內水深一丈五尺，倉庫漂盡，居人溺者甚眾。
units.en: In the sixth month of the third year many prefectures were inundated. At Xiang Prefecture the Han River surged into the city, where water stood fifteen feet deep. Storehouses were swept away entirely, and a great many residents drowned.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the third year, many prefectures suffered great flooding; the Han River at Xiang Prefecture rose and overflowed into the city, and within the city the water stood one zhang and five chi deep; storehouses were swept away entirely, and very many residents drowned.

units.zh: ○地震
units.en: ○ Earthquakes
units.literal: ○ Earthquakes

units.zh: 唐同光二年十一月，鎮州地震。
units.en: In the eleventh month of the second year of Tongguang of Later Tang, Zhen Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the second year of Tongguang of Tang, Zhen Prefecture had an earthquake.

units.zh: 三年十一月二十五日夜，魏、博、徐、宿地大震。
units.en: On the night of the twenty-fifth day of the eleventh month of the third year, Wei, Bo, Xu, and Su were struck by a major earthquake.
units.literal: On the night of the twenty-fifth day of the eleventh month of the third year, Wei, Bo, Xu, and Su regions suffered a great earthquake.

units.zh: 天成三年七月，鄭州地震。
units.en: In the seventh month of the third year of Tiancheng, Zheng Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the third year of Tiancheng, Zheng Prefecture had an earthquake.

units.zh: 長興二年六月，太原地震，自二十五日子時至二十七日申時，二十餘度。
units.en: In the sixth month of the second year of Changxing, Taiyuan was shaken by earthquakes from midnight on the twenty-fifth day until mid-afternoon on the twenty-seventh, more than twenty tremors in all.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the second year of Changxing, Taiyuan had earthquakes from the zi hour of the twenty-fifth day to the shen hour of the twenty-seventh day, more than twenty times.

units.zh: 左補闕李詳上疏曰：
units.en: Left Remonstrator Li Xiang submitted a memorial, saying:
units.literal: Left Remonstrator Li Xiang submitted a memorial saying:

units.zh: 臣聞天地之道，以簡易示人；
units.en: I have heard that the Way of Heaven and Earth is revealed to humanity through what is simple and direct;
units.literal: Your subject has heard that the Way of Heaven and Earth is to show men what is simple and easy;

units.zh: 鬼神之情，以禍福為務。
units.en: and that the intent of ghosts and spirits is to dispense blessing and calamity.
units.literal: the disposition of ghosts and spirits is to make blessing and calamity their task.

units.zh: 王者祥瑞至而不喜，災異見而輒驚，罔不寅畏上穹，思答天譴。
units.en: When a ruler receives auspicious omens he does not rejoice, but when disasters and portents appear he is immediately alarmed. None fail to revere Heaven above and seek to answer its rebuke.
units.literal: When a king sees auspicious omens arrive he does not rejoice; when disasters and anomalies appear he is immediately alarmed—none fail reverently to fear the upper vault and consider how to answer Heaven's reproof.

units.zh: 臣聞北京地震，日數稍多。
units.en: I have heard that earthquakes in the Northern Capital have continued for several days in unusual number.
units.literal: Your subject has heard that in the Northern Capital earthquakes have occurred over several days in somewhat greater number.

units.zh: 臣曾覽國書，伏見高宗時，晉州地震，上謂群臣曰：「豈朕政教之不明，使晉州地震耶？」
units.en: I once read the dynastic records and saw that in the reign of Emperor Gaozong of Tang, when Jin Prefecture was shaken, the emperor asked his ministers: "Could it be that my governance and teachings are unclear, and that this is why Jin Prefecture has been shaken?"
units.literal: Your subject once perused the dynastic records and saw that in the time of Emperor Gaozong, when Jin Prefecture had an earthquake, the emperor said to his ministers: "Could it be that my government and teachings are not clear, causing Jin Prefecture to earthquake?"

units.zh: 侍中張行成奏曰：「天陽也，地陰也，天陽君象，地陰臣象，君宜轉動，臣宜安靜。
units.en: Attendant-in-Chief Zhang Xingcheng replied: "Heaven is yang and Earth is yin. Heaven yang symbolizes the ruler; Earth yin symbolizes the minister. The ruler ought to be active; the minister ought to be still.
units.literal: Attendant-in-Chief Zhang Xingcheng memorialized: "Heaven is yang, Earth is yin; Heaven yang is the image of the ruler, Earth yin is the image of the minister. The ruler ought to move; the minister ought to be still.

units.zh: 今晉州地震，彌旬不休，將恐女謁使事，臣下陰謀。
units.en: Now Jin Prefecture has been shaking for more than ten days without cease. I fear that women may be meddling in affairs and that ministers may be plotting in secret.
units.literal: Now Jin Prefecture earthquakes continue for more than ten days without ceasing; I fear women interfering in affairs and ministers plotting in secret.

units.zh: 且晉州是陛下本封，今地震焉，尤彰其應。
units.en: Moreover, Jin Prefecture was Your Majesty's original fief. That it should now be shaken makes the omen all the more pointed.
units.literal: Moreover, Jin Prefecture is Your Majesty's original enfeoffment; now it earthquakes—this especially manifests the correspondence.

units.zh: 伏願深思遠慮，以杜未萌。」
units.en: I pray that Your Majesty will reflect deeply and plan far ahead to forestall what has not yet taken shape."
units.literal: Your subject wishes that deep thought and far-reaching consideration be applied to cut off what has not yet sprouted."

units.zh: 又，開元中，秦州地震，尋差官宣慰，兼降使致祭山川，所損之家，委量事安置奏聞。
units.en: Moreover, in the Kaiyuan era, when Qin Prefecture was shaken, officials were soon dispatched to comfort the people, and envoys were sent to offer sacrifices to the mountains and rivers. Damaged households were to be assisted as circumstances required and reported to the throne.
units.literal: Moreover, in the Kaiyuan era, when Qin Prefecture had an earthquake, officials were soon dispatched to comfort the people, and envoys were also sent down to offer sacrifices to mountains and rivers; households that suffered damage were entrusted for disposition according to circumstances and reported to the throne.

units.zh: 伏惟陛下中興唐祚，起自晉陽，地數震於帝鄉，理合思於天戒。
units.en: Your Majesty restored the Tang mandate, rising from Jinyang. That the earth should shake in the imperial homeland surely calls for reflection on Heaven's warning.
units.literal: Your subject considers that Your Majesty restored the Tang mandate, rising from Jinyang; the earth's numbers shake in the imperial homeland—reasonably one ought to reflect on Heaven's warning.

units.zh: 況聖明禦宇，於今六年，歲稔時康，人安俗阜。
units.en: Moreover, Your sagely rule has now endured six years, with abundant harvests, a peaceful age, a secure populace, and flourishing customs.
units.literal: Moreover, since Your sagely clarity has ruled the realm, it is now six years; harvests are abundant, the age is peaceful, the people are secure and customs flourishing.

units.zh: 臣慮天意恐陛下忘創業艱難之時，有功成矜滿之意。
units.en: I fear Heaven's intent may be to warn lest Your Majesty forget the hardships of founding the realm and grow complacent in success.
units.literal: Your subject fears that Heaven's intent may be lest Your Majesty forget the time of founding hardship and harbor the mind of complacency after achievement.

units.zh: 伏望特委親信，兼選勛賢，且往北京慰安，密令巡問黎民之疾苦，嚴山川之祭祀，然後鑒前朝得喪之本，采歷代聖哲之規，崇不諱之風，罷不急之務。
units.en: I pray that Your Majesty will specially commission trusted men and select meritorious worthies to go to the Northern Capital to comfort the people, secretly ordering them to inquire into the hardships of the common folk and to perform sacrifices to the mountains and rivers with due solemnity. Then take as your mirror the roots of rise and fall in former dynasties, adopt the standards of sage rulers through the ages, honor the spirit of frank counsel, and set aside non-urgent affairs.
units.literal: Your subject wishes that trusted persons be specially entrusted, and meritorious worthies also selected, to go first to the Northern Capital to comfort and reassure, secretly ordered to tour and inquire into the common people's hardships, strictly perform sacrifices to mountains and rivers, and then take as mirror the roots of gain and loss in former dynasties, adopt the regulations of sagely worthies through the ages, honor the spirit of not avoiding tabooed topics, and abolish unurgent affairs.

units.zh: 明宗深嘉之，錫以三品章服。
units.en: Emperor Mingzong greatly commended the memorial and bestowed third-rank ceremonial robes upon him.
units.literal: Emperor Mingzong deeply commended this and bestowed third-rank ceremonial robes.

units.zh: 十一月，雄武軍士上言，洛陽地震。
units.en: In the eleventh month soldiers of the Xiongwu Army reported that Luoyang had been shaken.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, soldiers of the Xiongwu Army reported that Luoyang had an earthquake.

units.zh: 三年八月，秦州地震。
units.en: In the eighth month of the third year, Qin Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake.
units.literal: In the eighth month of the third year, Qin Prefecture had an earthquake.

units.zh: 漢乾祐二年四月丁丑，幽、定、滄、營、深、貝等州地震，幽、定尤甚。
units.en: On the dingchou day of the fourth month of the second year of Qianyou of Later Han, You, Ding, Cang, Ying, Shen, Bei, and other prefectures were shaken by earthquakes, You and Ding most severely.
units.literal: On the dingchou day of the fourth month of the second year of Qianyou of Han, You, Ding, Cang, Ying, Shen, and Bei prefectures and others had earthquakes; You and Ding were especially severe.

units.zh: 周廣順三年十月，魏、邢、洺等州地震數日，凡十餘度，魏州尤甚。
units.en: In the tenth month of the third year of Guangshun of Later Zhou, Wei, Xing, Ming, and other prefectures were shaken for several days, more than ten tremors in all, Wei Prefecture most severely.
units.literal: In the tenth month of the third year of Guangshun of Zhou, Wei, Xing, Ming, and other prefectures had earthquakes for several days, more than ten times in all; Wei Prefecture was especially severe.

units.zh: ○蟲魚禽獸
units.en: ○ Insects, Fish, Birds, and Beasts
units.literal: ○ Insects, fish, birds, and beasts

units.zh: 梁龍德末，許州進綠毛龜，宮中造室以畜之，命之曰「龜堂」。
units.en: At the end of the Longde era of Later Liang, Xu Prefecture presented a green-haired tortoise. The palace built a chamber to house it and named it the "Hall of the Tortoise."
units.literal: At the end of Longde of Liang, Xu Prefecture presented a green-haired tortoise; within the palace a chamber was built to keep it, and it was named the "Hall of the Tortoise."

units.zh: 識者以為不祥之言。
units.en: Those versed in omens took this as an inauspicious name.
units.literal: Those with insight regarded this as an inauspicious saying.

units.zh: 唐天祐十八年二月，張文禮叛於鎮州，時野水變，其色如血，遊魚多死，浮於水上，識者知其必敗。
units.en: In the second month of the eighteenth year of Tianyou of Later Tang, Zhang Wenli rebelled at Zhen Prefecture. Wild waters turned the color of blood, fish died in great numbers and floated on the surface, and those versed in omens knew he was doomed to defeat.
units.literal: In the second month of the eighteenth year of Tianyou of Tang, Zhang Wenli rebelled at Zhen Prefecture; at that time wild waters changed, their color like blood; swimming fish mostly died and floated on the water; those with insight knew he would certainly be defeated.

units.zh: 十九年，定州王處直卒。
units.en: In the nineteenth year Wang Chuzhi of Ding Prefecture died.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year, Wang Chuzhi of Ding Prefecture died.

units.zh: 先是，處直自為德政碑，建樓於衙城內，言有龍見。
units.en: Earlier, Chuzhi had erected for himself a stele praising his virtuous governance and built a tower within the yamen compound, claiming that a dragon had appeared.
units.literal: Earlier, Chuzhi had himself erected a stele of virtuous governance and built a tower within the yamen city, saying that a dragon had appeared.

units.zh: 或睹之，其狀乃黃麽晰蜴也。
units.en: Those who saw it found the creature to be nothing but a yellow hemp-colored lizard.
units.literal: Some who saw it found its form to be a yellow hemp-colored lizard.

units.zh: 處直以為神異，造龍床以安之。
units.en: Chuzhi took it for a divine marvel and fashioned a dragon couch on which to install it.
units.literal: Chuzhi regarded it as divine and strange, and made a dragon couch to settle it there.

units.zh: 又，城東麥田中，有群鵲數百，平地為巢，處直以為己德所感。
units.en: Moreover, in the wheat fields east of the city several hundred magpies built nests on open ground, which Chuzhi took as a response to his own virtue.
units.literal: Moreover, in the wheat fields east of the city, several hundred magpies made nests on level ground; Chuzhi regarded this as moved by his own virtue.

units.zh: 識者竊論曰：「蟲蛇陰物，比藏山澤，今據屋室，人不得而有也。
units.en: Those versed in omens remarked privately: "Insects and serpents are creatures of yin, meant to dwell in mountains and marshes. To occupy human dwellings is something people ought not possess.
units.literal: Those with insight privately discussed, saying: "Insects and serpents are yin creatures; they compare to hiding in mountains and marshes—now they occupy houses and chambers, which people ought not to possess.

units.zh: 南方為火，火主禮，禮之壞則羽蟲失性，以文推之，上失其道，不安於位之兆也。」
units.en: The south corresponds to fire, and fire governs ritual. When ritual collapses, feathered creatures lose their proper nature. By this pattern one may infer an omen that the ruler has lost the Way and no longer holds his position securely."
units.literal: The south is fire; fire governs ritual. When ritual is ruined, feathered creatures lose their nature. Pushing by pattern, this is an omen that the ruler loses the Way and is not secure in his position."

units.zh: 果為其子都所廢。
units.en: In the end he was deposed by his son Wang Du.
units.literal: In the end he was deposed by his son Du.

units.zh: 應順元年閏正月丙寅辰時，唐閔帝幸至德宮，初出興教門，有飛鳶自空而落，死於御前，是日，大風晦冥。
units.en: At the chen hour on the bingyin day of the intercalary first month of the first year of Yingshun, Emperor Min of Later Tang visited Zhide Palace. As he first passed through Xingjiao Gate, a kite fell from the sky and died before him. That day brought fierce wind and murky darkness.
units.literal: At the chen hour on the bingyin day of the intercalary first month of the first year of Yingshun, Emperor Min of Tang visited Zhide Palace; as he first went out through Xingjiao Gate, a flying kite fell from the sky and died before the imperial presence; that day, great wind and dim obscurity.

units.zh: 清泰元年十月辛未巳時，有雉金色，自南飛入中書，止於政事堂之上，吏驅之不去，良久又北飛。
units.en: At the si hour on the xinwei day of the tenth month of the first year of Qingtai, a golden pheasant flew in from the south to the Secretariat and alighted atop the Hall of Administration. Clerks tried to drive it away, but it would not leave until, after a long while, it flew north again.
units.literal: At the si hour on the xinwei day of the tenth month of the first year of Qingtai, a golden-colored pheasant flew in from the south into the Secretariat and stopped atop the Hall of Administration; clerks drove it but it would not leave; after a long while it flew north again.

units.zh: 是日，民家得之。
units.en: That same day a common household captured it.
units.literal: That day, a common household caught it.

units.zh: 二年，鄴西李固鎮，有大鼠與蛇鬥於橋下，鬥及日之申，蛇不勝而死。
units.en: In the second year, at Ligu Town west of Ye, a huge rat and a serpent fought beneath a bridge until mid-afternoon, when the serpent was defeated and killed.
units.literal: In the second year, at Ligu Town west of Ye, a great rat and a serpent fought beneath a bridge; they fought until the shen hour of the day, and the serpent was defeated and died.

units.zh: 三年三月戊午，有蛇鼠鬥於洛陽師子門外，而鼠殺蛇。
units.en: On the wuwu day of the third month of the third year a serpent and a rat fought outside the Lion Gate of Luoyang, and the rat killed the serpent.
units.literal: On the wuwu day of the third month of the third year, a serpent and rat fought outside the Lion Gate of Luoyang, and the rat killed the serpent.

units.zh: 夏四月戊子，熊入市，形如人，搏人。
units.en: In summer, on the wuzi day of the fourth month, a bear entered the market, stood upright like a man, and attacked people.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the wuzi day, a bear entered the market, its form like a man, striking people.

units.zh: 又一熊自老君廟南走向城，會車駕幸近郊，從官射之而斃。
units.en: Another bear came from south of Laojun Temple toward the city just as the emperor was visiting the near suburbs. His attendants shot it dead.
units.literal: Another bear went from south of Laojun Temple toward the city; it happened that the imperial carriage was visiting the near suburbs, and attendants shot it and it died.

units.zh: 漢乾祐三年正月，有狐出明德樓，獲之，比常狐毛長，腹別有二足。
units.en: In the first month of the third year of Qianyou of Later Han a fox emerged from Mingde Tower and was captured. Its fur was longer than that of an ordinary fox, and it had an extra pair of feet on its belly.
units.literal: In the first month of the third year of Qianyou of Han, a fox came out from Mingde Tower; it was captured, and compared with ordinary foxes its fur was longer, and on its belly there were separately two feet.

units.zh: 周廣順三年六月，河北諸州旬日內無烏，既而聚澤、潞之間山谷中，集於林木，壓樹枝皆折。
units.en: In the sixth month of the third year of Guangshun of Later Zhou, crows vanished for ten days across the Hebei prefectures. They then gathered in the valleys between Ze and Lu, roosting so thickly on the trees that branches snapped under their weight.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the third year of Guangshun of Zhou, in the prefectures of Hebei for ten days there were no crows; afterward they gathered in the valleys between Ze and Lu, assembling on trees and shrubs, and branches pressed down all broke.

units.zh: 是年，人疾疫死者甚眾。
units.en: That year a great many people died of pestilence.
units.literal: That year, very many people died of epidemic disease.

units.zh: 至顯德元年，河東劉崇為周師所敗，伏屍流血，故先萌其兆。
units.en: By the first year of Xiande, Liu Chong of Hedong had been defeated by Zhou forces, with corpses strewn and blood flowing—thus the omen had foreshadowed what was to come.
units.literal: By the first year of Xiande, Liu Chong of Hedong was defeated by Zhou armies; corpses lay prostrate and blood flowed—therefore the omen had sprouted beforehand.

units.zh: 顯德元年三月，潞州高平縣有鵲巢於縣郭之南平地，巢中七八雛。
units.en: In the third month of the first year of Xiande, magpies built a nest on open ground south of the seat of Gaoping County in Lu Prefecture, with seven or eight fledglings within.
units.literal: In the third month of the first year of Xiande, in Gaoping County of Lu Prefecture magpies nested on level ground south of the county seat, with seven or eight fledglings in the nest.

units.zh: ○蝗
units.en: ○ Locusts
units.literal: ○ Locusts

units.zh: 梁開平元年六月，許、陳、汝、蔡、潁五州蝝生，有野禽群飛蔽空，食之皆盡。
units.en: In the sixth month of the first year of Kaiping of Later Liang locust nymphs appeared in Xu, Chen, Ru, Cai, and Ying prefectures. Wild birds flew in flocks that darkened the sky and devoured them all.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Kaiping of Liang, Xu, Chen, Ru, Cai, and Ying—the five prefectures—had locust nymphs; wild birds flew in flocks covering the sky and ate them all.

units.zh: 唐同光三年九月，鎮州奏，飛蝗害稼。
units.en: In the ninth month of the third year of Tongguang of Later Tang, Zhen Prefecture reported that flying locusts damaged the crops.
units.literal: In the ninth month of the third year of Tongguang of Tang, Zhen Prefecture reported that flying locusts damaged the crops.

units.zh: 晉天福七年四月，山東、河南、關西諸郡蝗害稼，至八年四月，天下諸州飛蝗害田，食草木葉皆盡。
units.en: In the fourth month of the seventh year of Tianfu of Later Jin, commanderies in Shandong, Henan, and Guanxi suffered locust damage to their crops. By the fourth month of the eighth year flying locusts ravaged fields throughout the realm, devouring grass, trees, and leaves until nothing remained.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the seventh year of Tianfu of Jin, the various commanderies of Shandong, Henan, and Guanxi suffered locust damage to crops; by the fourth month of the eighth year, flying locusts in prefectures throughout the realm damaged fields, eating grass, trees, and leaves until all were gone.

units.zh: 詔州縣長吏捕蝗，華州節度使楊彥詢、雍州節度使趙瑩命百姓捕蝗一斗，以祿粟一斗償之。
units.en: An edict ordered local officials to catch locusts. Military Governor Yang Yanxun of Hua Prefecture and Military Governor Zhao Ying of Yong Prefecture ordered the people to catch one dou of locusts in exchange for one dou of grain from official stores.
units.literal: An edict ordered prefectural and county chief officials to catch locusts; Military Governor of Hua Prefecture Yang Yanxun and Military Governor of Yong Prefecture Zhao Ying ordered the common people to catch one dou of locusts and compensated them with one dou of salary grain.

units.zh: 時蝗旱相繼，人民流移，饑者盈路，關西餓殍尤甚，死者十七八。
units.en: Locusts and drought followed one after another. People fled their homes in droves, and the hungry filled the roads. Guanxi suffered worst of all, with seven or eight in ten dying of starvation.
units.literal: At that time locusts and drought followed one another; the people drifted in displacement; the hungry filled the roads; in Guanxi the starved corpses were especially severe, seven or eight in ten dying.

units.zh: 朝廷以軍食不充，分命使臣諸道括粟麥，晉祚自茲衰矣。
units.en: Because military provisions ran short, the court dispatched envoys to the various circuits to requisition grain and wheat. From this point the fortunes of Later Jin began to decline.
units.literal: The court, because military provisions were insufficient, separately ordered envoys in the various circuits to requisition grain and wheat; the Jin mandate from this point declined.

units.zh: 漢乾祐元年七月，青、鄆、兗、齊、濮、沂、密、邢、曹皆言蝝生。
units.en: In the seventh month of the first year of Qianyou of Later Han, Qing, Yan, Yan, Qi, Pu, Yi, Mi, Xing, and Cao all reported locust nymphs.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Qianyou of Han, Qing, Yan, Yan, Qi, Pu, Yi, Mi, Xing, and Cao all reported the birth of locust nymphs.

units.zh: 開封府奏，陽武、雍丘、襄邑等縣蝗，開封尹侯益遣人以酒肴致祭，尋為鴝鵒食之皆盡。
units.en: Kaifeng Prefecture reported locusts in Yangwu, Yongqiu, Xiangyi, and other counties. Kaifeng Intendant Hou Yi sent men with wine and food to offer sacrifice, and soon myna birds ate the locusts to the last.
units.literal: Kaifeng Prefecture reported locusts in Yangwu, Yongqiu, Xiangyi, and other counties. Kaifeng Intendant Hou Yi sent men with wine and food to offer sacrifice; soon myna birds ate them all.

units.zh: 敕禁羅弋鴝鵒，以其有吞蝗之異也。
units.en: An edict forbade netting and shooting myna birds because of their remarkable ability to devour locusts.
units.literal: An edict forbade netting and shooting myna birds, because they had the marvel of devouring locusts.

units.zh: 二年五月，博州奏，有鴝生，化為蝶飛去。
units.en: In the fifth month of the second year Bo Prefecture reported that myna birds had been born and transformed into butterflies that flew away.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the second year, Bo Prefecture reported that myna birds were born and transformed into butterflies and flew away.

units.zh: 宋州奏，蝗一夕抱草而死，差官祭之。
units.en: Song Prefecture reported that locusts clung to the grass and died overnight; officials were dispatched to offer sacrifice.
units.literal: Song Prefecture reported that locusts clung to grass and died in a single night; officials were dispatched to offer sacrifice.

units.zh: 唐天成四年十一月，汝州火，燒羽林軍營五百餘間。
units.en: In the eleventh month of the fourth year of Tiancheng of Later Tang, a fire at Ru Prefecture burned more than five hundred buildings of the Imperial Guard camp.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the fourth year of Tiancheng of Tang, a fire at Ru Prefecture burned more than five hundred buildings of the Imperial Guard camp.

units.zh: 先是，司天奏，熒惑入羽林，飭京師為火備，至是果應。
units.en: Earlier the Directorate of Astronomy had reported that Mars had entered the Forest of Feathers constellation and ordered the capital to prepare against fire. Now the omen was fulfilled.
units.literal: Earlier, the Directorate of Astronomy reported that the Sparkling Deluder had entered the Forest of Feathers; the capital was ordered to prepare against fire; at this time it indeed corresponded.

units.zh: 長興二年四月辛丑，汴州封禪寺門扉上然火起，延燒近舍。
units.en: On the xinchou day of the fourth month of the second year of Changxing, fire broke out on the doors of Fengchan Temple in Bian Prefecture and spread to burn nearby houses.
units.literal: On the xinchou day of the fourth month of the second year of Changxing, at Fengchan Temple in Bian Prefecture fire suddenly arose on the door panels and spread to burn nearby houses.

units.zh: 是月，衛州奏，黎陽大火。
units.en: That same month Wei Prefecture reported a major fire at Liyang.
units.literal: That month, Wei Prefecture reported a great fire at Liyang.

units.zh: 先是，下詔於諸道，令為火備，至是驗之。
units.en: Earlier an edict had ordered the various circuits to prepare against fire, and now the warning was borne out.
units.literal: Earlier, an edict had been issued to the various circuits ordering preparations against fire; at this time it was verified.

units.zh: 三年十二月壬戌，懷州軍營內，三處火光自起，人至即滅，並不焚燒舍宇。
units.en: On the renxu day of the twelfth month of the third year, firelight appeared spontaneously in three places within the army camp at Huai Prefecture. It vanished as soon as anyone approached, and no buildings were burned.
units.literal: On the renxu day of the twelfth month of the third year, within the army camp at Huai Prefecture, firelight arose by itself in three places; when people arrived it immediately extinguished, and buildings were not burned at all.

units.zh: 明宗謂侍臣曰：「火妖乎？」
units.en: Emperor Mingzong asked his attending ministers: "Is this a fire demon?"
units.literal: Emperor Mingzong said to his attending ministers: "A fire demon?"

units.zh: 侍臣曰：「恐妖人造作，宜審詰之。」
units.en: The ministers replied: "We fear this was contrived by sorcerers. A thorough investigation should be ordered."
units.literal: The attending ministers said: "We fear demons made by men; it is fitting to investigate and interrogate thoroughly."

units.zh: 晉天福三年十一月，襄州奏，火燒居民千餘家。
units.en: In the eleventh month of the third year of Tianfu of Later Jin, Xiang Prefecture reported that fire had destroyed more than a thousand households.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the third year of Tianfu of Jin, Xiang Prefecture reported that fire burned more than a thousand households of residents.

units.zh: 九年春，左龍武統軍皇甫遇從少帝御契丹於鄆州北，將戰之夕，有火光熒熒然，生於牙竿之上。
units.en: In the spring of the ninth year, as Left Commander of the Dragon Martial Guard Huangfu Yu accompanied the Young Emperor to face the Khitans north of Yan Prefecture, flickering firelight appeared on the eve of battle atop the command pennant staff.
units.literal: In spring of the ninth year, Left Commander of the Dragon Martial Guard Huangfu Yu followed the Young Emperor to resist the Khitans north of Yan Prefecture; on the eve of the coming battle, firelight glowed flickering and was born atop the command pennant staff.

units.zh: 周顯德五年四月，吳越王錢俶奏，十日夜，杭州火，焚燒府署殆盡。
units.en: In the fourth month of the fifth year of Xiande of Later Zhou, King Qian Chu of Wuyue reported that on the night of the tenth, fire at Hangzhou had burned the government offices nearly to the ground.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the fifth year of Xiande of Zhou, King Qian Chu of Wuyue reported that on the night of the tenth day, Hangzhou had fire that burned the government offices nearly to completion.

units.zh: 世宗命中使賫詔撫問。
units.en: Emperor Shizong dispatched a palace envoy bearing an edict of consolation and inquiry.
units.literal: Emperor Shizong ordered a palace envoy to carry an edict in consolation and inquiry.

units.zh: 梁開平三年春正月，潞州軍前李思安奏，壺關縣庶穰鄉村人因伐樹倒，自分為兩片，內有六字，皆如左書，曰「天十四載石進」，乃圖其狀以進。
units.en: In the first month of spring of the third year of Kaiping of Later Liang, Li Si'an at the Lu Prefecture front memorialized that villagers of Shurang Township in Huguan County, while felling a tree, saw it fall and split in two; inside were six characters in clerical script reading "Heaven, the fourteenth year, Shi Jin." He painted its form and submitted the report.
units.literal: In the first month of spring of the third year of Kaiping of Liang, Li Si'an at the front of the Lu Prefecture army memorialized: villagers of Shurang Township in Huguan County, while felling a tree, saw it fall and split of itself into two pieces; within were six characters, all written like clerical script, reading "Heaven, the fourteenth year, Shi Jin." He painted its form and submitted it.

units.zh: 梁祖異之，命示百官，莫有詳其義者，及晉高祖即位，人以為雖有圖姓，計其甲子則二十有九年矣。
units.en: The Liang Founder regarded it as strange and ordered it shown to the hundred officials, but none could explain its meaning. When the Later Jin High Ancestor took the throne, people reckoned that although the diagram bore a surname, counting by the sexagenary cycle it had been twenty-nine years.
units.literal: The Liang Founder regarded it as strange and ordered it shown to the hundred officials; none could explain its meaning. When the Jin High Ancestor took the throne, people thought that although there was a surname in the diagram, counting by the sexagenary cycle it was twenty-nine years.

units.zh: 識者曰：「『天』字取『四』字中兩畫加之於傍，則『丙』字也；
units.en: Those versed in omens said: "Take the character for 'heaven' and add to its side the two strokes from the middle of the character for 'four,' and one gets the character for 'bing';
units.literal: Those with insight said: "Taking the character 'tian' and adding to its side the two strokes from the middle of the character 'si,' one gets the character 'bing';

units.zh: 『四』字去中間兩畫加『十』字，則『申』字也。
units.en: remove the middle two strokes from the character for 'four,' add the character for 'ten,' and one gets the character for 'shen.'
units.literal: removing the middle two strokes from the character 'si' and adding the character 'shi,' one gets the character 'shen.'

units.zh: 晉祖即位之年，乃丙申也。」
units.en: The year in which the Jin Ancestor took the throne was indeed bingshen."
units.literal: The year in which the Jin Ancestor took the throne was indeed bingshen."

units.zh: 唐天祐五年，長柳巷田家有僵桃樹，經年舊坎猶在，其仆木一朝屹然而起，行數十步，復於舊坎，其家駭異，倉皇散走。
units.en: In the fifth year of Tianyou of Later Tang, a farmer's home in Changliu Lane had a dead peach tree whose old root hollow still remained. One morning the fallen trunk suddenly stood upright, moved several dozen paces, and settled back into the old hollow. The household fled in terror.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Tianyou of Tang, at a farmer's home in Changliu Lane there was a stiff peach tree; the old pit from years past still remained; its fallen trunk one morning stood upright abruptly, walked several tens of paces, and returned to the old pit; the household was terrified and astonished and fled in haste.

units.zh: 議者以漢昭帝時，上林仆木起生枝，時蟲蠹成文而宣帝興。
units.en: Commentators cited the reign of Emperor Zhao of Han, when a fallen tree in Shanglin Park rose and put forth branches while insects bored characters into its wood, presaging the rise of Emperor Xuan.
units.literal: Discussants cited that in the time of Emperor Zhaodi of Han, a fallen tree in Shanglin Park rose and sprouted branches; at the time insects bored patterns into it and Emperor Xuandi rose.

units.zh: 今木理成文，仆而重起，乃莊宗中興之兆也。
units.en: Now the grain of the wood had formed characters, and a fallen tree had risen again—an omen of Emperor Zhuangzong's restoration of the Tang.
units.literal: Now the wood grain formed characters, fallen yet rising again—this was an omen of Emperor Zhuangzong's restoration.

units.zh: 同光元年冬十二月辛卯，亳州太清宮道士上言，聖祖殿前枯檜再生一枝，畫圖以進。
units.en: On the xinmao day of the twelfth month of winter in the first year of Tongguang, a Daoist priest of Taiqing Palace in Bo Prefecture reported that a withered cypress before the Hall of the Sagely Ancestor had sprouted a new branch. He submitted a painted record of the event.
units.literal: On the xinmao day of the twelfth month of winter in the first year of Tongguang, a Daoist priest of Taiqing Palace in Bo Prefecture reported upward that before the Hall of the Sagely Ancestor a withered cypress had put forth a new branch; a painted diagram was submitted.

units.zh: 清泰末年，末帝先人墳側古佛剎中石像，忽然搖動不已，觀者鹹訝焉。
units.en: Near the end of the Qingtai era, a stone image in an ancient Buddhist monastery beside the tomb of the Last Emperor's ancestors suddenly began to shake without cease, astonishing all who saw it.
units.literal: At the end of Qingtai, at an ancient Buddhist monastery beside the tomb of the Last Emperor's forebears, a stone image suddenly shook without cease; all who viewed it were astonished.

units.zh: 晉開運元年七月一日，少帝御明德門，宣赦改元。
units.en: On the first day of the seventh month of the first year of Kaiyun of Later Jin, the Young Emperor appeared at Mingde Gate, proclaimed an amnesty, and changed the reign title.
units.literal: On the first day of the seventh month of the first year of Kaiyun of Jin, the Young Emperor attended at Mingde Gate and proclaimed an amnesty and changed the reign title.

units.zh: 是日，遇大雷雨，門內有井亭，亭有石盆，有走水槽，槽有龍首，其夕悉飄行數十步，而龍首斷焉。
units.en: That day a violent thunderstorm struck. Inside the gate stood a well pavilion with a stone basin and a running-water channel bearing a dragon head. That evening all were swept several dozen paces, and the dragon head broke off.
units.literal: That day a great thunderstorm struck. Inside the gate was a well pavilion; the pavilion had a stone basin, the basin had a running-water channel, and the channel had a dragon head. That evening all drifted several tens of paces, and the dragon head broke off.

units.zh: 識者曰：「石，國姓也，此兆非祥，石氏其遷乎！
units.en: Those versed in omens said, "Stone is the dynastic surname. This omen is not auspicious. Will the Shi clan be displaced?
units.literal: Those with insight said: "Stone is the dynastic surname; this omen is not auspicious. Will the Shi clan be displaced?

units.zh: 其絕乎！」
units.en: Or will it be cut off?"
units.literal: Or will it be cut off?"

units.zh: 二年正月，汴州封丘門外，壕水東北隅水上有文，若大樹花葉芬敷之狀，相連數十株，宛若圖畫，傾都觀之。
units.en: In the first month of the second year, outside Fengqiu Gate in Bian Prefecture, patterns appeared on the water at the northeast corner of the moat like great trees in full bloom, linked in dozens of clusters like a painted scroll. The whole capital turned out to view them.
units.literal: In the first month of the second year, outside Fengqiu Gate in Bian Prefecture, on the water at the northeast corner of the moat there appeared patterns like great trees with flowers and leaves in full bloom, linked in several tens of clumps like a painted picture; the whole capital turned out to view them.

units.zh: 識者云：「唐景福中，盧彥威浮陽壕水有樹文亦如此，時有高尼辭郡人曰：『此地當有兵難。』
units.en: Those versed in omens remarked, "In the Jingfu era of Tang, tree patterns likewise appeared on the moat water at Fuyang under Lu Yanwei. At the time a nun took leave of the people of the commandery, saying, 'This place will suffer military calamity.'"
units.literal: Those with insight said: "In Jingfu of Tang, Lu Yanwei's Fuyang moat water also had tree patterns like this. At the time a lofty nun took leave of the people of the commandery, saying: 'This place will suffer military calamity.'"

units.zh: 至光化中，其郡果為燕帥劉仁恭所陷。」
units.en: By the Guanghua era that commandery was indeed overrun by the Yan commander Liu Rengong."
units.literal: By Guanghua, that commandery was indeed overrun by the Yan commander Liu Rengong."

units.zh: 三年九月，大水，太原葭蘆茂盛，最上一葉如旗狀，皆南指。
units.en: In the ninth month of the third year severe flooding struck. At Taiyuan reeds and rushes grew luxuriantly, their topmost leaves shaped like banners and all pointing south.
units.literal: In the ninth month of the third year there was great flooding. At Taiyuan reeds and rushes grew luxuriantly; the topmost leaf was like a banner, all pointing south.

units.zh: 十二月己丑，雨木冰。
units.en: On the jichou day of the twelfth month tree ice rained down.
units.literal: On the jichou day of the twelfth month, tree ice rained down.

units.zh: 是月戊戌，霜霧大降，草木皆如冰。
units.en: That same month, on the wuxu day, heavy frost and mist descended, and grass and trees were coated as with ice.
units.literal: That month, on the wuxu day, frost and mist fell heavily, and grass and trees were all like ice.

units.zh: 漢乾祐元年八月，李守貞叛於河中，境內蘆葉皆若旗旒之狀。
units.en: In the eighth month of the first year of Qianyou of Later Han, Li Shouzhen rebelled at Hezhong. Throughout the region reed leaves took the shape of banners and pennants.
units.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Qianyou of Han, Li Shouzhen rebelled at Hezhong; within the territory all reed leaves were like the form of banners and pennants.

units.zh: 周廣順三年春，樞密使王峻遙鎮青州，有司制旄節以備迎授。
units.en: In the spring of the third year of Guangshun of Later Zhou, as Privy Councilor Wang Jun was to assume distant command of Qing Prefecture, the relevant offices prepared imperial banners and credentials for his investiture.
units.literal: In spring of the third year of Guangshun of Zhou, Privy Councilor Wang Jun was to take distant command of Qing Prefecture; the relevant offices made imperial banners and credentials in preparation to welcome and invest him.

units.zh: 前夕，其節有聲。
units.en: On the eve of the ceremony the credentials emitted a sound.
units.literal: On the eve before, the credentials made a sound.

units.zh: 主者曰：「昔後唐長興中，安重誨授河中，其節亦有聲，斯亦木之妖也。」
units.en: The official in charge said: "In the Changxing era of Later Tang, when An Chonghui was invested at Hezhong, his credentials also made a sound. This too is an omen associated with wood."
units.literal: The person in charge said: "In former times, in Changxing of Later Tang, when An Chonghui was invested at Hezhong, his credentials also made a sound—this too is a demon of wood."
